title: Vibrant Steamed Chinese Rhubarb Mushimono
description: A flavorful, satvik-friendly dim-sum dish featuring rhubarb and mushrooms, steamed in corn husks. Great for a quick snack or meal prep.
instructions: Rinse and cut the rhubarb into 1-inch pieces.
Prepare the corn husks by soaking them in water for 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together sesame oil, soy sauce, grated ginger, and minced garlic.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Place a few pieces of rhubarb and a few mushrooms in the center of each corn husk.
Fold the husk over the filling and tie with kitchen twine.
Steam the mushimono over boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until the rhubarb is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions.
Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 24 hours and reheat before serving.
